name: astute-functions
description: What Astute's server does for a reader: reads what they did, works out what they know and like, deals their day, assembles Explore.

scripts.data: cp ../web/cards/cards.json data/bank.json && python3 -c "import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'../tool/cards');import genres;json.dump({t:[{'id':g.id,'label':g.label,'strands':[{'id':s.id,'label':s.label} for s in g.strands]} for g in gl] for t,gl in genres.by_topic().items()},open('data/genres.json','w'),indent=1)"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
